## Bookings

### getBusinessProfile

`bookings.getBusinessProfile`

Retrieves a seller's booking profile.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.bookings.getBusinessProfile({});
```

**Input:** _empty object_


**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `business_booking_profile` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="business_booking_profile full type">

```ts

  seller_id?: string | null,
```

## Cards

### create

`cards.create`

Adds a card on file to an existing merchant. Requires idempotency_key; pass the same key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.cards.create({
	idempotency_key: '<idempotency key>',
	source_id: '<source id>',
	card: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A unique string that identifies this CreateCard request. Keys can be any valid string and must be unique for every request. |
| `source_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the source which represents the card information to be stored. This can be a card nonce or a payment id. |
| `verification_token` | `string` | No | An identifying token generated by Payments.verifyBuyer(). |
| `card` | `object` | Yes | Payment details associated with the card to be stored. |

### disable

`cards.disable`

Disables the card, preventing any further updates or charges. Disabling an already disabled card is allowed but has no effect. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.cards.disable({ card_id: '<card id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `card_id` | `string` | Yes | Unique ID for the desired Card. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `card` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### list

`cards.list`

Retrieves a list of cards owned by the account making the request. A max of 25 cards will be returned.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.cards.list({ cursor: '<cursor>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cursor` | `string` | No | A pagination cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Provide this to retrieve the next set of results for your original query. |
| `customer_id` | `string` | No | Limit results to cards associated with the customer supplied. By default, all cards owned by the merchant are returned. |
| `include_disabled` | `boolean` | No | Includes disabled cards. By default, all enabled cards owned by the merchant are returned. |
| `reference_id` | `string` | No | Limit results to cards associated with the reference_id supplied. |
| `sort_order` | `DESC \| ASC` | No | Sorts the returned list by when the card was created with the specified order. This field defaults to ASC. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cards` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,

  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
```

## Catalog

### delete

`catalog.delete`

Deletes a single CatalogObject based on the provided ID and returns the set of successfully deleted IDs in the response. Deletion is a cascading event such that all children of the targeted object are also deleted. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.catalog.delete({ object_id: '<object id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `object_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the catalog object to be deleted. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `deleted_object_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | — |
| `deleted_at` | `string \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>



---

### get

`catalog.get`

Returns a single CatalogItem as a CatalogObject based on the provided ID.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.catalog.get({ object_id: '<object id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `object_id` | `string` | Yes | The object ID of any type of catalog objects to be retrieved. |
| `include_related_objects` | `boolean` | No | If `true`, the response will include additional objects that are related to the requested objects. |
| `catalog_version` | `number` | No | Requests objects as of a specific version of the catalog. This allows you to retrieve historical versions of objects. |
| `include_category_path_to_root` | `boolean` | No | Specifies whether or not to include the `path_to_root` list for each returned category instance. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `object` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `related_objects` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,
```

---

### list

`catalog.list`

Returns a list of all CatalogObjects of the specified types in the catalog.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.catalog.list({ cursor: '<cursor>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cursor` | `string` | No | The pagination cursor returned in the previous response. Leave unset for an initial request. The page size is currently set to be 100. See Pagination for more information. |
| `types` | `string` | No | An optional case-insensitive, comma-separated list of object types to retrieve. |
| `catalog_version` | `number` | No | The specific version of the catalog objects to be included in the response. This allows you to retrieve historical versions of objects. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `objects` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

---

### search

`catalog.search`

Searches for CatalogObject of any type by matching supported search attribute values, excluding custom attribute values on items or item variations, against one or more of the specified query filters.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.catalog.search({ cursor: '<cursor>', limit: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `cursor` | `string` | No | The pagination cursor returned in the previous response. Leave unset for an initial request. See Pagination for more information. |
| `object_types` | `(ITEM \| IMAGE \| CATEGORY \| ITEM_VARIATION \| TAX \| DISCOUNT \| MODIFIER_LIST \| MODIFIER \| PRICING_RULE \| PRODUCT_SET \| TIME_PERIOD \| MEASUREMENT_UNIT \| SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN_VARIATION \| ITEM_OPTION \| ITEM_OPTION_VAL \| CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE_DEFINITION \| QUICK_AMOUNTS_SETTINGS \| SUBSCRIPTION_PLAN \| AVAILABILITY_PERIOD)[]` | No | The desired set of object types to appear in the search results. |
| `include_deleted_objects` | `boolean` | No | If `true`, deleted objects will be included in the results. Defaults to `false`. Deleted objects will have their `is_deleted` field set to `true`. |
| `include_related_objects` | `boolean` | No | If `true`, the response will include additional objects that are related to the requested objects. |
| `begin_time` | `string` | No | Return objects modified after this timestamp, in RFC 3339 format, e.g., `2016-09-04T23:59:33.123Z`. |
| `query` | `object` | No | A query to be used to filter or sort the results. If no query is specified, the entire catalog will be returned. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | A limit on the number of results to be returned in a single page. The limit is advisory - the implementation may return more or fewer results. |
| `include_category_path_to_root` | `boolean` | No | Specifies whether or not to include the `path_to_root` list for each returned category instance. |
| `include_options` | `object` | No | Options to include related resources in the response. |

---

### upsert

`catalog.upsert`

Creates a new or updates the specified CatalogObject. Replaces the whole object: any field left out of the request is cleared, nested variations included. Requires idempotency_key; pass the same key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.catalog.upsert({
	idempotency_key: '<idempotency key>',
	object: { type: 'ITEM', id: '<id>' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A value you specify that uniquely identifies this request among all your requests. A common way to create a valid idempotency key is to use a Universally unique identifier (UUID). |
| `object` | `object` | Yes | A CatalogObject to be created or updated. |

Replaces the whole object: any field left out of the request is cleared, nested variations included. Read it with `catalog.get` first and send it back complete.

## Custom Attribute Definitions

### customer.create

`customAttributeDefinitions.customer.create`

Creates a customer-related custom attribute definition for a Square seller account. Use this endpoint to define a custom attribute that can be associated with customer profiles. The definition name is required if visibility is VISIBILITY_READ_ONLY or VISIBILITY_READ_WRITE_VALUES. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.customAttributeDefinitions.customer.create({
	custom_attribute_definition: {
		key: '<key>',
		schema: { $ref: 'https://developer-production-s.squarecdn.com/schemas/v1/common.json#squareup.common.String' },
	},
});
```

### update

`customers.update`

Updates a customer profile. This endpoint supports sparse updates, so only new or changed fields are required in the request. To add or update a field, specify the new value. To remove a field, specify `null`.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.customers.update({ customer_id: '<customer id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `given_name` | `string \| null` | No | The given name (that is, the first name) associated with the customer profile. |
| `family_name` | `string \| null` | No | The family name (that is, the last name) associated with the customer profile. |
| `company_name` | `string \| null` | No | A business name associated with the customer profile. |
| `nickname` | `string \| null` | No | A nickname for the customer profile. |
| `email_address` | `string \| null` | No | The email address associated with the customer profile. |
| `address` | `object` | No | The physical address associated with the customer profile. Only new or changed fields are required in the request. |
| `phone_number` | `string \| null` | No | The phone number associated with the customer profile. The phone number must be valid and can contain 9–16 digits, with an optional `+` prefix and country code. |
| `reference_id` | `string \| null` | No | An optional second ID used to associate the customer profile with an entity in another system. |
| `note` | `string \| null` | No | A custom note associated with the customer profile. |
| `birthday` | `string \| null` | No | The birthday associated with the customer profile, in `YYYY-MM-DD` or `MM-DD` format. For example, specify `1998-09-21` for September 21, 1998, or `09-21` for September 21. |
| `version` | `number` | No | The current version of the customer profile. |
| `tax_ids` | `object` | No | The tax ID associated with the customer profile. This field is available only for customers of sellers in EU countries or the United Kingdom. |
| `customer_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the customer to update. |

## Disputes

### accept

`disputes.accept`

Accepts the loss on a dispute. Square returns the disputed amount to the cardholder and updates the dispute state to ACCEPTED. Moves money. Square takes no idempotency_key here; disputes.get shows whether the dispute is already accepted before you repeat the call. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.disputes.accept({ dispute_id: '<dispute id>' });
```

|------|------|----------|-------------|

### createEvidenceFile

`disputes.createEvidenceFile`

Uploads a file to use as evidence in a dispute challenge. The endpoint accepts HTTP multipart/form-data file uploads in HEIC, HEIF, JPEG, PDF, PNG, and TIFF formats.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.disputes.createEvidenceFile({
	dispute_id: '<dispute id>',
	idempotency_key: '<idempotency key>',
	file_base64: 'aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=',
	filename: 'evidence.txt',
	content_type: 'image/png',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A unique key identifying the request. For more information, see Idempotency. |
| `evidence_type` | `GENERIC_EVIDENCE \| ONLINE_OR_APP_ACCESS_LOG \| AUTHORIZATION_DOCUMENTATION \| CANCELLATION_OR_REFUND_DOCUMENTATION \| CARDHOLDER_COMMUNICATION \| CARDHOLDER_INFORMATION \| PURCHASE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT \| DUPLICATE_CHARGE_DOCUMENTATION \| PRODUCT_OR_SERVICE_DESCRIPTION \| RECEIPT \| SERVICE_RECEIVED_DOCUMENTATION \| PROOF_OF_DELIVERY_DOCUMENTATION \| RELATED_TRANSACTION_DOCUMENTATION \| REBUTTAL_EXPLANATION \| TRACKING_NUMBER` | No | The type of evidence you are uploading. See DisputeEvidenceType for possible values |
| `content_type` | `string` | No | The MIME type of the uploaded file. The type can be image/heic, image/heif, image/jpeg, application/pdf, image/png, or image/tiff. |
| `dispute_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the dispute for which you want to upload evidence. |
| `file_base64` | `string` | Yes | The file's bytes, base64-encoded (standard or URL-safe; a data: URL prefix is accepted). |
| `filename` | `string` | Yes | File name sent with the upload, for example receipt.jpg. |

`file_base64` is the file; `content_type` (in the JSON part) is its MIME type. Sent as multipart with the file in `image_file`.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `evidence` | `object \| null` | No | — |

<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,

  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
}[] | null
```

```ts
  dispute_id?: string | null,

    filename?: string | null,

  } | null,

  uploaded_at?: string | null,
  evidence_type?: string | null
} | null
```

### create

`invoices.create`

Creates a draft invoice for an order created using the Orders API. Give delivery_method (recommended) or the deprecated request_method on each payment request; the schema does not require delivery_method for that reason. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.create({
	invoice: {
		order_id: '<order id>',
		payment_requests: [{ request_type: 'BALANCE', due_date: '2026-11-30' }],
		accepted_payment_methods: { card: true },
	},
});
```

**Input**

### createAttachment

`invoices.createAttachment`

Uploads a file and attaches it to an invoice. This endpoint accepts HTTP multipart/form-data file uploads with a JSON `request` part and a `file` part.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.createAttachment({ invoice_id: '<invoice id>', file_base64: 'aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=', filename: 'evidence.txt' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | No | A unique string that identifies the `CreateInvoiceAttachment` request. For more information, see Idempotency. |
| `description` | `string` | No | The description of the attachment to display on the invoice. |
| `invoice_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the invoice to attach the file to. |
| `file_base64` | `string` | Yes | The file's bytes, base64-encoded (standard or URL-safe; a data: URL prefix is accepted). |
| `filename` | `string` | Yes | File name sent with the upload, for example receipt.jpg. |
| `content_type` | `string` | No | MIME type of the file, for example application/pdf or image/png. Defaults to the type Square's spec shows, image/jpeg. |

`content_type` is the file's MIME type and defaults to `image/jpeg`. Sent as multipart with the file in `image_file`.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `attachment` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<Accordion title="attachment full type">

```ts
} | null
```

### delete

`invoices.delete`

Deletes the specified invoice. When an invoice is deleted, the associated order status changes to CANCELED. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.delete({ invoice_id: '<invoice id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `invoice_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the invoice to delete. |
| `version` | `number` | No | The version of the invoice to delete. If you do not know the version, you can call GetInvoice or ListInvoices. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### deleteAttachment

`invoices.deleteAttachment`

Removes an attachment from an invoice and permanently deletes the file. Attachments can be removed only from invoices in the `DRAFT`, `SCHEDULED`, `UNPAID`, or `PARTIALLY_PAID` state. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.deleteAttachment({ invoice_id: '<invoice id>', attachment_id: '<attachment id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `invoice_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the invoice to delete the attachment from. |
| `attachment_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the attachment to delete. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
</AccordionGroup>

### list

`invoices.list`

Returns a list of invoices for a given location. The response is paginated. If truncated, the response includes a `cursor` that you use in a subsequent request to retrieve the next set of invoices.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.list({ location_id: '<location id>', cursor: '<cursor>', limit: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `location_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the location for which to list invoices. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | A pagination cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Provide this cursor to retrieve the next set of results for your original query. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | The maximum number of invoices to return (200 is the maximum `limit`). If not provided, the server uses a default limit of 100 invoices. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `invoices` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### publish

`invoices.publish`

Publishes the specified draft invoice. Sends the invoice to the customer and may charge the card on file; cancel with invoices.cancel. Moves money. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.publish({ invoice_id: '<invoice id>', version: 0 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `version` | `number` | Yes | The version of the invoice to publish. This must match the current version of the invoice; otherwise, the request is rejected. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string \| null` | No | A unique string that identifies the `PublishInvoice` request. |
| `invoice_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the invoice to publish. |

Needs the invoice `version` from `invoices.get`. Square then emails the customer and/or charges the card on file, depending on the invoice.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `invoice` | `object \| null` | No | — |
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### search

`invoices.search`

Searches for invoices from a location specified in the filter. You can optionally specify customers in the filter for whom to retrieve invoices.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.search({
	query: {
		filter: {
			location_ids: ['<location ids>'],
		},
	},
	cursor: '<cursor>',
	limit: 1,
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `query` | `object` | Yes | Describes the query criteria for searching invoices. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | The maximum number of invoices to return (200 is the maximum `limit`). If not provided, the server uses a default limit of 100 invoices. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | A pagination cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Provide this cursor to retrieve the next set of results for your original query. |

### update

`invoices.update`

Updates an invoice. This endpoint supports sparse updates, so you only need to specify the fields you want to change along with the required `version` field. Some restrictions apply to updating invoices. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.invoices.update({
	invoice_id: '<invoice id>',
	invoice: {},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `invoice` | `object` | Yes | The invoice fields to add, change, or clear. Fields can be cleared using null values or the `remove` field (for individual payment requests or reminders). |
| `idempotency_key` | `string \| null` | No | A unique string that identifies the `UpdateInvoice` request. |
| `fields_to_clear` | `string[] \| null` | No | The list of fields to clear. Although this field is currently supported, we recommend using null values or the `remove` field when possible. For examples, see Update an Invoice. |
| `invoice_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the invoice to update. |

## Locations

### create

`locations.create`

Creates a location. Creating new locations allows for separate configuration of receipt layouts, item prices, and sales reports. Locations can't be deleted; deactivate with locations.update.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.locations.create({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `location` | `object` | No | The initial values of the location being created. The `name` field is required and must be unique within a seller account. |

Locations can't be deleted; deactivate one with `locations.update`.

### get

`locations.get`

Retrieves details of a single location. Specify "main" as the location ID to retrieve details of the main location.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.locations.get({ location_id: '<location id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `location_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the location to retrieve. Specify the string "main" to return the main location. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `location` | `object \| null` | No | — |

## Merchants

### get

`merchants.get`

Retrieves the `Merchant` object for the given `merchant_id`.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.merchants.get({ merchant_id: '<merchant id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `merchant_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the merchant to retrieve. If the string "me" is supplied as the ID, then retrieve the merchant that is currently accessible to this call. |

Pass `me` as `merchant_id` for the merchant that owns the access token.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `merchant` | `object \| null` | No | — |

## Orders

### calculate

`orders.calculate`

Enables applications to preview order pricing without creating an order. A fulfillment's pickup_details, shipment_details or in_store_details is required when its type is PICKUP, SHIPMENT or IN_STORE. A line item modifier's base_price_money is required for ad hoc modifiers. Beta in Square's API; it may change.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.orders.calculate({
	order: { location_id: '<location id>' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `order` | `object` | Yes | The order to be calculated. Expects the entire order, not a sparse update. |
| `proposed_rewards` | `object[] \| null` | No | Identifies one or more loyalty reward tiers to apply during the order calculation. |

---

### create

`orders.create`

Creates a new order that can include information about products for purchase and settings to apply to the purchase. A fulfillment's pickup_details, shipment_details or in_store_details is required when its type is PICKUP, SHIPMENT or IN_STORE. A line item modifier's base_price_money is required for ad hoc modifiers. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.orders.create({
	idempotency_key: '<a unique key>',
	order: {
		location_id: '<location id>',
		line_items: [{
			name: 'Coffee',
			quantity: '1',
			base_price_money: { amount: 350, currency: 'USD' },
		}],
	},
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `order` | `object` | No | The order to create. If this field is set, the only other top-level field that can be set is the `idempotency_key`. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | No | A value you specify that uniquely identifies this order among orders you have created. |

### pay

`orders.pay`

Pay for an order using one or more approved payments or settle an order with a total of `0`. Approved payments for the same order_id that are not listed in payment_ids are canceled. Moves money. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Beta in Square's API; it may change.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.orders.pay({
	order_id: '<order id>',
	idempotency_key: '<a unique key; reuse it to retry>',
	payment_ids: ['<payment id>'],
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A value you specify that uniquely identifies this request among requests you have sent. |
| `order_version` | `number \| null` | No | The version of the order being paid. If not supplied, the latest version will be paid. |
| `payment_ids` | `string[] \| null` | No | The IDs of the payments to collect. The payment total must match the order total. |
| `order_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the order being paid. |

The total of `payment_ids` must equal the order total. Approved payments that reference this `order_id` but are not listed in `payment_ids` are canceled.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `order` | `object \| null` | No | — |

---

### search

`orders.search`

Search all orders for one or more locations. Orders include all sales, returns, and exchanges regardless of how or when they entered the Square ecosystem (such as Point of Sale, Invoices, and Connect APIs).

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.orders.search({ cursor: '<cursor>', limit: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `location_ids` | `string[]` | No | The location IDs for the orders to query. All locations must belong to the same merchant. |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | A pagination cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Provide this cursor to retrieve the next set of results for your original query. |
| `query` | `object` | No | Query conditions used to filter or sort the results. Note that when retrieving additional pages using a cursor, you must use the original query. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | The maximum number of results to be returned in a single page. |
| `return_entries` | `boolean` | No | A Boolean that controls the format of the search results. If `true`, `SearchOrders` returns OrderEntry objects. If `false`, `SearchOrders` returns complete order objects. |

---

### update

`orders.update`

Updates an open order by adding, replacing, or deleting fields. Orders with a `COMPLETED` or `CANCELED` state cannot be updated. A fulfillment's pickup_details, shipment_details or in_store_details is required when its type is PICKUP, SHIPMENT or IN_STORE. A line item modifier's base_price_money is required for ad hoc modifiers. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Beta in Square's API; it may change.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.orders.update({ order_id: '<order id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `order` | `object` | No | The sparse order containing only the fields to update and the version to which the update is being applied. |
| `fields_to_clear` | `string[] \| null` | No | The dot notation paths fields to clear. For example, `line_items[uid].note`. For more information, see Deleting fields. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string \| null` | No | A value you specify that uniquely identifies this update request. |
| `order_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the order to update. |

---

## Payment Links

### create

`paymentLinks.create`

Creates a Square-hosted checkout page. Applications can share the resulting payment link with their buyer to pay for goods and services. A fulfillment's pickup_details, shipment_details or in_store_details is required when its type is PICKUP, SHIPMENT or IN_STORE. A line item modifier's base_price_money is required for ad hoc modifiers. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.paymentLinks.create({});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | No | A unique string that identifies this `CreatePaymentLinkRequest` request. |
| `description` | `string` | No | A description of the payment link. You provide this optional description that is useful in your application context. It is not used anywhere. |
| `quick_pay` | `object` | No | Describes an ad hoc item and price for which to generate a quick pay checkout link. For more information, see Quick Pay Checkout. |
| `order` | `object` | No | Describes the `Order` for which to create a checkout link. For more information, see Square Order Checkout. |
| `checkout_options` | `object` | No | Describes optional fields to add to the resulting checkout page. For more information, see Optional Checkout Configurations. |
| `pre_populated_data` | `object` | No | Describes fields to prepopulate in the resulting checkout page. For more information, see Prepopulate the shipping address. |
| `payment_note` | `string` | No | A note for the payment. After processing the payment, Square adds this note to the resulting `Payment`. |

```ts
	id: '<id>',
	payment_link: { version: 1 },
});
```

## Payments

### cancel

`payments.cancel`

Cancels (voids) a payment. You can use this endpoint to cancel a payment with the APPROVED `status`. Moves money. Square takes no idempotency_key here; payments.get shows whether the payment is already canceled before you repeat the call. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.cancel({ payment_id: '<payment id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `payment_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the payment to cancel. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `payment` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### cancelByIdempotencyKey

`payments.cancelByIdempotencyKey`

Voids a payment by the idempotency_key of the payments.create call that made it; use when that call's response was lost. Moves money. Its idempotency_key names the payment to cancel; it does not make this call repeatable. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.cancelByIdempotencyKey({ idempotency_key: '<the idempotency_key of the payments.create call to void>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | The `idempotency_key` identifying the payment to be canceled. |

The `idempotency_key` here names the payment to cancel (the key of the `payments.create` call that made it). It does not make this call repeatable.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

```ts
  category?: string | null,

  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
}[] | null
```

### complete

`payments.complete`

Completes (captures) a payment. By default, payments are set to complete immediately after they are created. Moves money. Square takes no idempotency_key here; payments.get shows whether the payment is already completed before you repeat the call.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.complete({ payment_id: '<payment id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `version_token` | `string \| null` | No | Used for optimistic concurrency. This opaque token identifies the current `Payment` version that the caller expects. |
| `payment_id` | `string` | Yes | The unique ID identifying the payment to be completed. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `payment` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### create

`payments.create`

Creates a payment using the provided source. customer_id is required if source_id is a card on file created with the Cards API. Moves money. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.create({
	source_id: 'cnon:card-nonce-ok',
	idempotency_key: '<a unique key; reuse it to retry this charge>',
	amount_money: { amount: 1000, currency: 'USD' },
	location_id: '<location id>',
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `source_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID for the source of funds for this payment. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A unique string that identifies this `CreatePayment` request. Keys can be any valid string but must be unique for every `CreatePayment` request. |
| `amount_money` | `object` | No | The amount of money to accept for this payment, not including `tip_money`. |
| `tip_money` | `object` | No | The amount designated as a tip, in addition to `amount_money`. |
| `app_fee_money` | `object` | No | The amount of money that the developer is taking as a fee for facilitating the payment on behalf of the seller. |
| `app_fee_allocations` | `Record<string, any>[]` | No | Details pertaining to recipients of the application fee. The sum of the amounts in the app_fee_allocations must equal the app_fee_money amount, if present. |
| `delay_duration` | `string` | No | The duration of time after the payment's creation when Square automatically either completes or cancels the payment depending on the `delay_action` field value. |
| `delay_action` | `string` | No | The action to be applied to the payment when the `delay_duration` has elapsed. The action must be CANCEL or COMPLETE. For more information, see Time Threshold. |
| `autocomplete` | `boolean` | No | If set to `true`, this payment will be completed when possible. |
| `order_id` | `string` | No | Associates a previously created order with this payment. |
| `customer_id` | `string` | No | The Customer ID of the customer associated with the payment. |
| `location_id` | `string` | No | The location ID to associate with the payment. If not specified, the main location is used. |
| `team_member_id` | `string` | No | An optional TeamMember ID to associate with this payment. |
| `reference_id` | `string` | No | A user-defined ID to associate with the payment. |
| `verification_token` | `string` | No | An identifying token generated by payments.verifyBuyer(). |
| `accept_partial_authorization` | `boolean` | No | If set to `true` and charging a Square Gift Card, a payment might be returned with `amount_money` equal to less than what was requested. |
| `buyer_email_address` | `string` | No | The buyer's email address. |
| `buyer_phone_number` | `string` | No | The buyer's phone number. Must follow the following format: 1. A leading + symbol (followed by a country code) 2. |
| `billing_address` | `object` | No | The buyer's billing address. |
| `shipping_address` | `object` | No | The buyer's shipping address. |
| `note` | `string` | No | An optional note to be entered by the developer when creating a payment. |
| `statement_description_identifier` | `string` | No | Optional additional payment information to include on the customer's card statement as part of the statement description. |
| `cash_details` | `object` | No | Additional details required when recording a cash payment (`source_id` is CASH). |
| `external_details` | `object` | No | Additional details required when recording an external payment (`source_id` is EXTERNAL). |
| `customer_details` | `object` | No | Details about the customer making the payment. |
| `offline_payment_details` | `object` | No | An optional field for specifying the offline payment details. This is intended for internal 1st-party callers only. |

Pass `source_id` from Square's Web Payments SDK, a card on file (`cards.create`), or in the sandbox the test nonce `cnon:card-nonce-ok`. The payment completes immediately unless you set `autocomplete: false`; finish a delayed one with `payments.complete`.

### get

`payments.get`

Retrieves details for a specific payment.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.get({ payment_id: '<payment id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `payment_id` | `string` | Yes | A unique ID for the desired payment. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `payment` | `object \| null` | No | — |

### list

`payments.list`

Retrieves a list of payments taken by the account making the request.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.list({ cursor: '<cursor>', limit: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `begin_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the start of the time range to retrieve payments for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `created_at` field for each Payment. Inclusive. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the end of the time range to retrieve payments for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `created_at` field for each Payment. |
| `sort_order` | `string` | No | The order in which results are listed by `ListPaymentsRequest.sort_field`: - `ASC` - Oldest to newest. - `DESC` - Newest to oldest (default). |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | A pagination cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Provide this cursor to retrieve the next set of results for the original query. |
| `location_id` | `string` | No | Limit results to the location supplied. By default, results are returned for the default (main) location associated with the seller. |
| `total` | `number` | No | The exact amount in the `total_money` for a payment. |
| `last_4` | `string` | No | The last four digits of a payment card. |
| `card_brand` | `string` | No | The brand of the payment card (for example, VISA). |
| `limit` | `number` | No | The maximum number of results to be returned in a single page. It is possible to receive fewer results than the specified limit on a given page. |
| `is_offline_payment` | `boolean` | No | Whether the payment was taken offline or not. |
| `offline_begin_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the start of the time range for which to retrieve offline payments, in RFC 3339 format for timestamps. The range is determined using the `offline_payment_details. |
| `offline_end_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the end of the time range for which to retrieve offline payments, in RFC 3339 format for timestamps. The range is determined using the `offline_payment_details. |
| `updated_at_begin_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the start of the time range to retrieve payments for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `updated_at` field for each Payment. |
| `updated_at_end_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the end of the time range to retrieve payments for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `updated_at` field for each Payment. |
| `sort_field` | `CREATED_AT \| OFFLINE_CREATED_AT \| UPDATED_AT` | No | The field used to sort results by. The default is `CREATED_AT`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `payments` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### refund

`payments.refund`

Refunds a payment. You can refund the entire payment amount or a portion of it. You can use this endpoint to refund a card payment or record a refund of a cash or external payment. customer_id is required if destination_id is a card on file created with the Cards API, and is only allowed when unlinked=true. Moves money. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely. Cannot be undone.

**Risk:** `destructive` · **Irreversible**

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.refund({
	idempotency_key: '<a unique key; reuse it to retry this refund>',
	payment_id: '<payment id>',
	amount_money: { amount: 500, currency: 'USD' },
});
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A unique string that identifies this `RefundPayment` request. The key can be any valid string but must be unique for every `RefundPayment` request. |
| `amount_money` | `object` | Yes | The amount of money to refund. |
| `app_fee_money` | `object` | No | The amount of money the developer contributes to help cover the refunded amount. |
| `app_fee_allocations` | `Record<string, any>[] \| null` | No | Details pertaining to contributors to the refund of the application fee. The sum of the amounts in the app_fee_allocations must equal the app_fee_money amount, if present. |
| `payment_id` | `string \| null` | No | The unique ID of the payment being refunded. Required when unlinked=false, otherwise must not be set. |
| `destination_id` | `string \| null` | No | The ID indicating where funds will be refunded to. Required for unlinked refunds. For more information, see Process an Unlinked Refund. |
| `unlinked` | `boolean \| null` | No | Indicates that the refund is not linked to a Square payment. If set to true, `destination_id` and `location_id` must be supplied while `payment_id` must not be provided. |
| `location_id` | `string \| null` | No | The location ID associated with the unlinked refund. Required for requests specifying `unlinked=true`. Otherwise, if included when `unlinked=false`, will throw an error. |
| `customer_id` | `string \| null` | No | The Customer ID of the customer associated with the refund. This is required if the `destination_id` refers to a card on file created using the Cards API. |
| `reason` | `string \| null` | No | A description of the reason for the refund. |
| `payment_version_token` | `string \| null` | No | Used for optimistic concurrency. This opaque token identifies the current `Payment` version that the caller expects. |
| `team_member_id` | `string \| null` | No | An optional TeamMember ID to associate with this refund. |
| `cash_details` | `object` | No | Additional details required when recording an unlinked cash refund (`destination_id` is CASH). |
| `external_details` | `object` | No | Additional details required when recording an unlinked external refund (`destination_id` is EXTERNAL). |

Pass `payment_id` and `amount_money`. A refund cannot be reversed; use a new `idempotency_key` for a second refund, and the same one to retry the first.

</Accordion>

---

### update

`payments.update`

Updates a payment with the APPROVED status. You can update the `amount_money` and `tip_money` using this endpoint. Moves money. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.payments.update({ payment_id: '<payment id>', idempotency_key: '<idempotency key>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `payment` | `object` | No | The updated `Payment` object. |
| `idempotency_key` | `string` | Yes | A unique string that identifies this `UpdatePayment` request. Keys can be any valid string but must be unique for every `UpdatePayment` request. |
| `payment_id` | `string` | Yes | The ID of the payment to update. |

## Refunds

### get

`refunds.get`

Retrieves a specific refund using the `refund_id`.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.refunds.get({ refund_id: '<refund id>' });
```

| `refund_id` | `string` | Yes | The unique ID for the desired `PaymentRefund`. |

| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |

### list

`refunds.list`

Retrieves a list of refunds for the account making the request.

**Risk:** `read`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.refunds.list({ cursor: '<cursor>', limit: 1 });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `begin_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the start of the time range to retrieve each `PaymentRefund` for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `created_at` field for each `PaymentRefund`. |
| `end_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the end of the time range to retrieve each `PaymentRefund` for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `created_at` field for each `PaymentRefund`. |
| `sort_order` | `string` | No | The order in which results are listed by `PaymentRefund.created_at`: - `ASC` - Oldest to newest. - `DESC` - Newest to oldest (default). |
| `cursor` | `string` | No | A pagination cursor returned by a previous call to this endpoint. Provide this cursor to retrieve the next set of results for the original query. |
| `location_id` | `string` | No | Limit results to the location supplied. By default, results are returned for all locations associated with the seller. |
| `status` | `string` | No | If provided, only refunds with the given status are returned. For a list of refund status values, see PaymentRefund. |
| `source_type` | `string` | No | If provided, only returns refunds whose payments have the indicated source type. Current values include `CARD`, `BANK_ACCOUNT`, `WALLET`, `CASH`, and `EXTERNAL`. |
| `limit` | `number` | No | The maximum number of results to be returned in a single page. |
| `updated_at_begin_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the start of the time range to retrieve each `PaymentRefund` for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `updated_at` field for each `PaymentRefund`. |
| `updated_at_end_time` | `string` | No | Indicates the end of the time range to retrieve each `PaymentRefund` for, in RFC 3339 format. The range is determined using the `updated_at` field for each `PaymentRefund`. |
| `sort_field` | `CREATED_AT \| UPDATED_AT` | No | The field used to sort results by. The default is `CREATED_AT`. |



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `refunds` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `cursor` | `string \| null` | No | — |

### updateSignatureKey

`webhookSubscriptions.updateSignatureKey`

Updates a webhook subscription by replacing the existing signature key with a new one. The old signature key stops verifying as soon as the new one is issued. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely.

**Risk:** `write`

```ts
await corsair.square.api.webhookSubscriptions.updateSignatureKey({ subscription_id: '<subscription id>' });
```

**Input**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `idempotency_key` | `string \| null` | No | A unique string that identifies the UpdateWebhookSubscriptionSignatureKey request. |
| `subscription_id` | `string` | Yes | [REQUIRED] The ID of the Subscription to update. |

The old signature key stops verifying as soon as the new one is issued.



**Output**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| `errors` | `object[] \| null` | No | — |
| `signature_key` | `string \| null` | No | — |

<AccordionGroup>
<Accordion title="errors full type">

```ts
{
  category?: string | null,
  code?: string | null,
  detail?: string | null,
  field?: string | null
}[] | null
```
</Accordion>
